## How the Hall updates

- Names, creators, and links are read from the original credits page.
- The README links here; static artwork does not claim completed replacements.
- Honored requires a dedicated [proof record](data/assimilation-proofs.json), human-approved complete parity, a pinned acceptance report and a published, downloadable ARS ZIP release.
- Public development focus comes from the existing [GitHub roadmap](ROADMAP.md); internal working plans are never displayed.
- No original third-party mod icons or artwork are added to this credit index.

Explore the [Hall of Heroes](HALL_OF_HEROES.md), [live roadmap](ROADMAP.md) and [project home](../README.md).
